tale.jaymoskingdoms.bring.short: That's not all of it. I need %1$s of %2$s.
tale.jaymoskingdoms.mercy: Go. Don't let me see you again.
tale.jaymoskingdoms.plea: Enough. I yield. Let me walk.
tale.jaymoskingdoms.howgoes: You're back. How goes it with %1$s?
tale.jaymoskingdoms.howgoes.give_up: I'm done with it. Find someone else.
tale.jaymoskingdoms.howgoes.given_up: Then it stays as it is. I won't forget who left it so.
tale.jaymoskingdoms.gave_up: I walked away from it. Whatever came of it, came without me.
tale.jaymoskingdoms.giver_died: %1$s is dead, and what they asked of me died with them.
tale.jaymoskingdoms.resting: Nothing to do for now but wait.
tale.jaymoskingdoms.goal.stash: Leave it in the chest at %2$s
tale.jaymoskingdoms.goal.lamps: Light the dark corners of %2$s before nightfall
tale.jaymoskingdoms.runner.0: Been after you since morning. This is for you.
tale.jaymoskingdoms.runner.1: You're a hard one to find. A letter, sealed. I was told your hand only.
tale.jaymoskingdoms.runner.2: Here. Paid for at the other end, so I'll not wait on an answer.
tale.jaymoskingdoms.back.thanks: I said I'd not forget it. I haven't.
tale.jaymoskingdoms.back.recruit: You let me walk once. I've nowhere worth walking to. Take me on?
tale.jaymoskingdoms.back.revenge: You should have finished it when you had the chance.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.cut_down.0: I saw what you did to %2$s, %1$s. They'd put their blade down.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.cut_down.1: %2$s had yielded, %1$s. I was there. I see it still.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.cut_down.2: Keep your hands where I can see them, %1$s. I remember %2$s.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.about.cut_down.0: %1$s killed %2$s after they'd yielded. I'd not turn my back on that one.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.about.cut_down.1: Ask %1$s what became of %2$s. No, don't. I saw it.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.heard.cut_down.0: %3$s says you cut down %2$s when they'd already yielded, %1$s. Is that so?
recall.jaymoskingdoms.heard.cut_down.1: They talk about you and %2$s, %1$s. %3$s saw the end of it.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.mercy.0: You had %2$s beaten and you let them walk, %1$s. Not many would.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.mercy.1: I think of it now and then, %1$s. %2$s, on the ground, and you standing back.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.mercy.2: %1$s. The one who spared %2$s. I've told that story more than once.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.about.mercy.0: %1$s had %2$s at their mercy and gave it. That's worth knowing about a person.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.about.mercy.1: %1$s could have killed %2$s. Didn't. Make of that what you like.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.heard.mercy.0: %3$s says you let %2$s go when you needn't have, %1$s.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.heard.mercy.1: You spared %2$s, I hear. %3$s tells it well, %1$s.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.night.rumour.tale: Someone at the next table would not stop telling it, and it stuck: %s
tale.jaymoskingdoms.back.warning: You let me go, so I'll tell you once. Folk are asking after you. Watch the road.
tale.jaymoskingdoms.leaves.mercy.0: They had yielded. I won't walk beside a hand that does that.
tale.jaymoskingdoms.leaves.mercy.1: There was no need for it. None. I'm done following you.
tale.jaymoskingdoms.leaves.faith.0: That was holy ground. I'll not stand with you after this.
tale.jaymoskingdoms.leaves.faith.1: The gods saw that. So did I. Go on without me.
tale.jaymoskingdoms.leaves.law.0: I kept the law my whole life. I won't break it for your purse.
tale.jaymoskingdoms.leaves.law.1: You've thrown in with thieves. Then you can go with them, not me.
tale.jaymoskingdoms.leaves.courage.0: You ran. I didn't sign on behind someone who runs.
tale.jaymoskingdoms.leaves.courage.1: You left them to it. I'll not wait to see who you leave next.
tale.jaymoskingdoms.leaves.honour.0: You gave your word and broke it. Mine's broken with you.
tale.jaymoskingdoms.leaves.honour.1: A liar's company is no company. I'm going.
tale.jaymoskingdoms.leaves.gain.0: You turned down good coin. I can't eat your fine feelings. I'm off.
tale.jaymoskingdoms.leaves.gain.1: All that, for nothing? Find someone who works for free.
tale.jaymoskingdoms.leaves.vengeance.0: They walk free after that? Then I walk too. Away from you.
tale.jaymoskingdoms.leaves.vengeance.1: Some wrongs you answer. You didn't. We're finished.
tale.jaymoskingdoms.leaves.self.0: I trusted you with this. Of all of it, with this. Go your way.
tale.jaymoskingdoms.leaves.self.1: That was mine to decide, and you knew it. I'm leaving.
tale.jaymoskingdoms.leaves.failed.0: I asked you for one thing. I'll not ask again. Goodbye.
tale.jaymoskingdoms.leaves.failed.1: I thought you'd see me through. I was wrong about you.
tale.jaymoskingdoms.goal.name: Tell %1$s who did it
tale.jaymoskingdoms.not_now.night: Not here, not in daylight. Find me after dark.
tale.jaymoskingdoms.not_now.day: Not at this hour. Come back when it's light.
tale.jaymoskingdoms.not_now.moon_full: Not tonight. When the moon is full.
tale.jaymoskingdoms.not_now.moon_new: Not tonight. Wait for a night with no moon.
tale.jaymoskingdoms.refuse.dice.0: Hard luck. The dice don't know your name either.
tale.jaymoskingdoms.refuse.dice.1: That's mine, then. They fall how they fall.
tale.jaymoskingdoms.refuse.persuade.0: No. Say what you like, the answer's no.
tale.jaymoskingdoms.refuse.persuade.1: Fine words. They don't change a thing.
tale.jaymoskingdoms.refuse.threaten.0: Is that meant to frighten me? I've been frightened by better.
tale.jaymoskingdoms.refuse.threaten.1: Lay a hand on me and see how far you get in this town.
tale.jaymoskingdoms.refuse.bribe.0: Put your purse away. I'm not for sale.
tale.jaymoskingdoms.refuse.bribe.1: Keep your coin. And keep your voice down when you offer it.
tale.jaymoskingdoms.voice.mercy.0: Go gently with this one. Please.
tale.jaymoskingdoms.voice.mercy.1: Nobody has to bleed for this. Remember that.
tale.jaymoskingdoms.voice.faith.0: Mind what's holy here before you answer.
tale.jaymoskingdoms.voice.faith.1: The gods are listening to this. So am I.
tale.jaymoskingdoms.voice.law.0: There's a law for this. Keep to it.
tale.jaymoskingdoms.voice.law.1: Do it by the book, or don't do it.
tale.jaymoskingdoms.voice.courage.0: Don't back away from it. Not this.
tale.jaymoskingdoms.voice.courage.1: If there's a hard road here, that's ours.
tale.jaymoskingdoms.voice.honour.0: Whatever you say now, you'll be held to it.
tale.jaymoskingdoms.voice.honour.1: Give them the truth. We're not liars.
tale.jaymoskingdoms.voice.gain.0: Mind what it pays before you say yes.
tale.jaymoskingdoms.voice.gain.1: There's coin in this somewhere. Don't talk us out of it.
tale.jaymoskingdoms.voice.vengeance.0: Someone has to answer for this. Don't let them off.
tale.jaymoskingdoms.voice.vengeance.1: They'd not spare us. Remember that.
tale.jaymoskingdoms.voice.agree.0: Good. That's what I'd have done.
tale.jaymoskingdoms.voice.differ.0: I'd not have done that. But it's done.
tale.jaymoskingdoms.voice.differ.1: You know what I think of that. I'll say no more.
tale.jaymoskingdoms.name.ask: Then say it. Who was it?
tale.jaymoskingdoms.reader.offer: You can't read that, can you. I can. It's a coin to have it read.
tale.jaymoskingdoms.reader.no: No. I'll keep it to myself.
tale.jaymoskingdoms.reader.read.0: There. That's what it says, word for word.
tale.jaymoskingdoms.reader.read.1: That's all of it. I'd think on who else you show it to.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.193: Some tales won't wait for you. If the asker names a day, the tale goes on without you when it passes, and ends its own way.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.194: People keep hours. Some are only at the tavern after dark, and some things can only be done by night, or only by day.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.195: What you wear, your blood, your patron and your name in a town change what people say to you, and what they offer.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.196: You can try to persuade, threaten or pay your way through a talk. The reply says how it's likely to go. A try is made once.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.197: Learn what a beast fears before you fight it. Carry it into the fight and the beast is weaker, and your bestiary keeps the note.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.198: A letter in a tongue you can't read stays shut to you until you learn the tongue, or pay a priest or a librarian to read it aloud. Then they know what it says too.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.199: A lie told in a tale can come out weeks later. So can thanks: a letter, a new neighbour, talk at the inn.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.200: Now and then a notice on the town board is the start of a tale, written in the asker's own hand.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.201: Wolfsbane turns up now and then when you cut fern. The one who walks at the moon can't abide it.
